🌟 thedeck | Dart
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a digital, cooperative platform for playing classic card games on mobile devices, with a shared visual interface.
✨ Key Features: • Cross-platform mobile support (Android, iOS) • Built with Flutter and Dart • Unique 'table' device feature for shared gameplay • Supports classic card games • Offline multiplayer capabilities
📖 Summary: The Deck is an open-source, cross-platform mobile card game engine built with Flutter. It allows users to play classic card games digitally, with a unique feature where one device acts as a shared 'table' visible to all players, enhancing cooperative gameplay.
